description: This file defines the WatchReplyCoordinator class responsible for managing reply events from a watch interface. It handles deduplication, queuing when the gateway is disconnected, and provides decision logic for processing watch reply events.

classes.name: WatchReplyCoordinator
classes.description: A coordinator class for handling watch reply events, including deduplication and queuing based on connection status.

methods.name: ingest
methods.description: Processes an incoming WatchQuickReplyEvent, determines whether to drop, deduplicate, queue, or forward based on replyId, actionId, and connection status.

methods.name: drainIfConnected
methods.description: Returns queued events if the connection is active and clears the queue.

methods.name: requeueFront
methods.description: Re-inserts an event at the front of the queue.

methods.name: queuedCount
methods.description: Returns the number of queued reply events.
